residualGuarantees.claim: folder `.` maps to `\"root\"`; folders with `/` or `\\` are coalesced into a single-segment slug with `_` separators; otherwise the folder string is returned unchanged after stripping leading `./`
residualGuarantees.reason: single source of truth for the sidecar slug across generate, validate, and reporter. Three call sites previously inlined this logic; agreement is the contract.

residualContract.body: branchCoverageFromSpecTests is null when coverage-summary.json is absent or inconsistent with the folder's source files (loud-fail signal for the gate); never null after a clean pnpm test --coverage run
residualContract.reason: lifecycle contract; null is the gate's only stale-data channel because v8 reports per-file totals, not per-test.

residualGuarantees.claim: builds a `SpecMeta` from analysis-derived type coverage + run-level args (generatedAtSha, thresholds); populates classifierCoverage/preconditionPassRate/branchCoverageFromSpecTests from `execution` when present
residualGuarantees.reason: emit's frontmatter + sidecar both require meta; `--implemented` mode merges Vitest reporter stats into the gate inputs.

residualGuarantees.claim: regenerates the SpecArtifact and returns the pretty-printed JSON used for on-disk diff; a `SidecarSchemaError` here is a defect (the artifact came from our own emitter)
residualGuarantees.reason: validate's sidecar-drift cross-check needs the byte-for-byte regenerated form; the schema must succeed on artifacts we emit.

residualContract.body: metrics whose threshold is 0 are not gated regardless of observed value
residualContract.reason: zero-threshold is the explicit no-gate marker used by the permissive default config.

residualGuarantees.claim: returns the first observed-below-threshold metric (typeCoverage to precondition order) or null when all gates pass
residualGuarantees.reason: validate emits one MissingImplError per folder; first failing gate is the surfaced one.

residualContract.body: unreadable test files contribute the empty string to the hash; the reporter applies the same convention so a transient read failure doesn't poison the hash

residualGuarantees.claim: reads the given test paths from disk, normalizes them to POSIX slashes, sorts by path, and returns the sha256 hex digest — the freshness-gate input validate compares against the on-disk execution sidecar's `testTreeHash`
residualGuarantees.reason: Windows-host runs would otherwise hash with `\` separators while the reporter writes POSIX. Normalizing here keeps the comparison stable across hosts.

residualContract.body: internal section ordering is fixed: Purpose → Public Surface → Files → Properties
residualContract.reason: behavioral contract beyond the FolderAnalysis shape.

residualGuarantees.claim: two calls with the same `analysis` + `meta` produce byte-identical markdown; frontmatter decodes through `decodeSpecFrontmatter`
residualGuarantees.reason: roundtrip contract on the emit step.

residualContract.body: spec-test attribution holds only if coverage-summary.json came from a vitest run restricted to *.spec.test.ts files; this repo enforces it via vitest.config.ts test.include
residualContract.reason: v8 coverage attributes per-file, not per-test; without the include narrowing the aggregate would credit ordinary tests toward branchCoverageFromSpecTests.

residualGuarantees.claim: aggregates v8 branch coverage for the folder's immediate sources; null when coverage-summary.json is absent, an expected source has no entry, or a matching file did not execute; 1.0 when present-and-fully-branchless
residualGuarantees.reason: validate's `--implemented` gate consumes branchCoverageFromSpecTests; the null/1.0 split lets it distinguish "user forgot --coverage" from "folder is just re-exports."

residualContract.body: fields the codemod cannot yet compute (e.g. per-export sourceRef.sha) reuse `meta.generatedAtSha` as the closest stable identifier
residualContract.reason: per-line blame would require a separate git pass; the run-level SHA is a sound default for now.

residualGuarantees.reason: sidecar contract; downstream agents consume this shape.

residualGuarantees.claim: loads the per-folder execution sidecar emitted by the Vitest reporter, decoded through `ExecutionSidecarSchema`; returns null when absent or malformed
residualGuarantees.reason: validate's `--implemented` gate consumes the coverage values; absence is surfaced separately as a typed gap error.
